note: These are strong surface gender signals only. They do not by themselves prove singular vs plural, so number-sensitive clitic conclusions must remain conservative.

These forms were explicitly reviewed as singular subjects in project sentences; exact review can therefore supply number where suffix shape alone cannot. Wiilku is supported by the native-reviewed focus sentence ‘Wiilku muus buu cunay.’
Third-person plural also uses ay/way. Never conclude that a masculine -ku/-gu subject must take wuu unless singular number is independently supported.
